sub.scene: A doctor points at a simple body chart while a patient touches their sore shoulder, in a bright exam room.
A tired person in pajamas sits on a sofa with a blanket, a tissue box and a thermometer on the table.

Two paramedics lift a stretcher into an ambulance while a bystander holds a first aid kit nearby.

sub.scene: A person sits cross-legged and calm on a mat beside a desk with a folder and a small insurance card.

words.ex: My head hurts after the long meeting.
My stomach hurts when I skip breakfast.
words.tip: Dạ dày; "stomach ache" là đau bụng.

words.ex: I have a pain in my lower back.
My throat feels dry and sore today.
words.tip: Cổ họng; "sore throat" là viêm họng.

words.ex: He felt a tight pain in his chest.
words.tip: Ngực; đau ngực cần đi khám ngay.

words.ex: She carries a heavy bag on one shoulder.
I hurt my knee while running.
He rested his elbow on the table.
words.tip: Khuỷu tay; "tennis elbow" là viêm lồi cầu.

words.ex: My wrist hurts when I type all day.
She twisted her ankle on the stairs.
words.tip: Mắt cá chân — hay bị trật.

words.ex: The sun can dry out your skin.
words.tip: Da; "sensitive skin" là da nhạy cảm.

words.ex: He broke a bone in his arm.
words.tip: Xương; "bone density" là mật độ xương.

words.ex: I pulled a muscle at the gym.
My joints feel stiff in cold weather.
Regular exercise is good for your heart.
Smoking damages your lungs over time.
The nurse took a sample of my blood.
I felt a sharp pain in my side.
I have a dull ache in my neck.
words.tip: Cơn đau âm ỉ, khác "pain" nhói.

words.ex: My neck is stiff from sitting too long.
Good posture protects your spine.
words.def: the line of bones down the middle of your back

words.ex: My legs feel stiff after the flight.
words.def: hard to bend or move easily

words.ex: I caught a cold after the rain.
words.tip: Cảm lạnh; "catch a cold" là bị cảm.

words.ex: I've had a dry cough for three days.
The child has a high fever tonight.
Half of my class has the flu.
words.tip: Cúm; "flu shot" là tiêm vắc-xin cúm.

words.ex: I get a headache when I skip lunch.
My legs are sore after the long hike.
words.tip: Đau nhức, ê ẩm (không phải vết thương hở).
words.def: painful, especially when touched or used

words.ex: I stayed home because I felt sick.
words.tip: Ốm; "call in sick" là gọi xin nghỉ ốm.

words.ex: He looked pale and ill this morning.
I feel tired even after eight hours of sleep.
words.def: needing rest or sleep

words.ex: I felt dizzy when I stood up too fast.
The medicine caused mild nausea.
The baby vomited twice during the night.
Drink plenty of water if you have diarrhea.
words.tip: Tiêu chảy, nhớ uống bù nước.
words.def: an illness with frequent, watery bowel movements

words.ex: A red rash spread across his arm.
words.def: an area of red spots on the skin

words.ex: I have an allergy to peanuts.
words.tip: Dị ứng; "allergic to" là tính từ đi kèm.

words.ex: She is allergic to cats and dust.
words.def: having a bad reaction to something such as food or dust

words.ex: The cut got an infection after two days.
A new virus is spreading in our town.
His left foot was red and swollen.
words.tip: Sưng; quá khứ phân từ của "swell".
words.def: larger than normal because of injury or illness

words.ex: My eyes are itchy in spring.
words.def: making you want to scratch your skin

words.ex: The kids all have a runny nose this week.
words.def: a nose that is producing a lot of liquid

words.ex: Fever is a common symptom of the flu.
He lives with chronic back pain.
Chickenpox is highly contagious.
She uses an inhaler to control her asthma.
A migraine kept her in bed all day.
words.tip: Đau nửa đầu, nặng hơn đau đầu thường.

words.ex: Constant fatigue made it hard to work.
words.tip: Kiệt sức kéo dài; trang trọng hơn "tired".

words.ex: I have an appointment with the doctor at ten.
words.tip: Bác sĩ — từ cơ bản nhất.

words.ex: The nurse checked my temperature first.
He spent two nights in the hospital.
The clinic opens at eight every morning.
words.tip: Phòng khám, nhỏ hơn bệnh viện.

words.ex: I picked up my medicine at the pharmacy.
The pharmacist explained how to take the pills.
words.tip: Dược sĩ, người bán thuốc ở hiệu thuốc.

words.ex: Take this medicine twice a day.
Take one pill after dinner.
One tablet in the morning is enough.
words.tip: Viên nén; Anh-Anh dùng nhiều hơn "pill".

words.ex: The doctor wrote me a prescription.
words.tip: Đơn thuốc; chỉ mua được khi có đơn.

words.ex: I made an appointment for Monday morning.
I go for a check-up once a year.
The nurse took my temperature.
Put the thermometer under your arm.
The doctor ordered a blood test.
They took an X-ray of my chest.
The diagnosis was a mild stomach infection.
The treatment lasts about two weeks.
Do not take more than one dose a day.
A common side effect is feeling sleepy.
Rub the ointment gently on the rash.
She put a bandage on his finger.
words.tip: Băng gạc; cuộn quanh vết thương.

words.ex: The nurse gave me an injection in the arm.
Children get this vaccine at the age of two.
He needs surgery on his knee.
words.tip: Phẫu thuật; còn nghĩa "phòng khám" ở Anh.

words.ex: It took her a week to recover from the flu.
My doctor sent me to a heart specialist.
You can buy this over-the-counter without a prescription.
words.tip: Thuốc không kê đơn, mua ngay quầy.

words.ex: We sat in the waiting room for an hour.
words.def: a room where people sit before seeing a doctor

words.ex: Call 115 in an emergency.
words.tip: Khẩn cấp; "emergency room" là phòng cấp cứu.

words.ex: Someone called an ambulance right away.
There was a bad accident on the highway.
He missed the match because of a knee injury.
Two people were injured in the crash.
words.def: hurt in an accident or attack

words.ex: Clean the wound with warm water.
The cut kept bleeding for a few minutes.
She got a burn on her hand from the stove.
I got a small cut on my finger.
He has a broken leg and cannot walk.
words.def: having a bone that has cracked or split

words.ex: The scan showed a small fracture in his wrist.
She has a sprain in her left ankle.
words.def: an injury to a joint caused by twisting it

words.ex: The fall left a big bruise on my arm.
words.def: a dark mark on the skin after a hit

words.ex: He fainted in the heat and fell down.
The driver was unconscious when help arrived.
The baby began to choke on a grape.
words.def: to be unable to breathe because something blocks your throat

words.ex: Take a deep breath and breathe slowly.
words.tip: Thở; động từ, danh từ là "breath".

words.ex: Everyone should learn basic first aid.
He had a heart attack at the age of sixty.
words.tip: Nhồi máu cơ tim; gọi cấp cứu ngay.

words.ex: The paramedics reached the scene in six minutes.
words.tip: Nhân viên cấp cứu y tế.
words.def: a trained person who gives emergency medical help

words.ex: This is urgent, please come quickly.
Keep poison away from small children.
An overdose of painkillers can be dangerous.
words.def: too much of a drug taken at one time

words.ex: Daily exercise keeps me healthy.
words.tip: Tập thể dục; không đếm được khi nói chung.

words.ex: She eats a healthy lunch every day.
He changed his diet to lose weight.
words.tip: Chế độ ăn; "on a diet" là đang ăn kiêng.

words.ex: I need eight hours of sleep.
Eat more vegetables with every meal.
An apple is a healthy fruit snack.
Too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
I try not to eat much junk food.
words.tip: Đồ ăn vặt nhiều dầu mỡ, ít dinh dưỡng.
words.vi: đồ ăn vặt kém dinh dưỡng
words.def: food that is quick to eat but not healthy

words.ex: Oranges are full of vitamin C.
Eggs are a good source of protein.
One slice of cake has many calories.
words.def: a unit for measuring the energy in food

words.ex: He lost some weight last year.
words.tip: Cân nặng; "lose weight" là giảm cân.

words.ex: I go to the gym three times a week.
My morning workout takes thirty minutes.
words.def: a session of physical exercise

words.ex: I jog around the park before work.
Stretch your legs before you run.
He stays fit by cycling to work.
words.tip: Cân đối, khỏe; "keep fit" = giữ dáng.

words.ex: My uncle quit smoking last year.
He doesn't smoke or drink.
Drinking water in the morning is a good habit.
Stay hydrated during long runs.
words.def: having enough water in your body

words.ex: A balanced meal has protein and vegetables.
words.def: containing the right amounts of different things

words.ex: Good nutrition helps children learn better.
Running builds endurance over time.
Work stress keeps me awake at night.
words.tip: Căng thẳng; "under stress" là đang bị áp lực.

words.ex: I feel stressed before exams.
words.def: feeling worried and under pressure

words.ex: She felt anxious before the interview.
He sees a therapist for his anxiety.
He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.def: feeling very sad and without hope

words.ex: Depression is an illness, not weakness.
words.tip: Bệnh trầm cảm; khác với "buồn" nhất thời.

words.ex: My mood improves after a walk.
I relax by listening to quiet music.
Don't worry, it's just a small cold.
Stay calm and breathe slowly.
I was exhausted after the night shift.
words.def: extremely tired

words.ex: Long hours can lead to burnout.
words.tip: Kiệt sức vì công việc, "cháy" hết.
words.def: extreme tiredness caused by too much work or stress

words.ex: He has had insomnia for months.
She started therapy to deal with stress.
words.tip: Liệu pháp, trị liệu tâm lý.

words.ex: My therapist teaches me to manage stress.
Mental health is as important as physical health.
I meditate for ten minutes each morning.
words.def: to sit quietly and clear your mind

words.ex: My insurance pays for most doctor visits.
Does your insurance cover dental work?
words.tip: Chi trả (bảo hiểm); nghĩa gốc "che phủ".

words.ex: I filed a claim for my hospital bill.
words.tip: Yêu cầu bồi thường bảo hiểm.

words.ex: My monthly premium went up this year.
This policy covers family members too.
I pay the first 200 dollars as my deductible.
words.tip: Mức tự chi trả trước khi bảo hiểm trả.

words.ex: Her coverage includes dental and eye care.
Sleep is important for your well-being.
words.tip: Sức khỏe tổng thể, trạng thái tốt.

phrases.en: Where does it hurt?
phrases.vi: Bạn đau ở đâu?

phrases.vi: Tôi đau khi cử động cánh tay.

phrases.vi: Tôi bị đau ở phần lưng dưới.

phrases.en: My knee has been sore since Monday.
phrases.vi: Đầu gối tôi bị đau từ hôm thứ Hai.

phrases.en: I don't feel well.
phrases.vi: Tôi thấy không khỏe.

phrases.en: I think I have a fever.
phrases.vi: Tôi nghĩ là mình bị sốt.

phrases.en: I've had a cough for three days.
phrases.vi: Tôi bị ho ba ngày rồi.

phrases.en: I feel dizzy and a bit sick.
phrases.vi: Tôi thấy chóng mặt và hơi buồn nôn.

phrases.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.
phrases.vi: Tôi dị ứng với penicillin.

phrases.en: I'd like to make an appointment.
phrases.vi: Tôi muốn đặt lịch hẹn khám.

phrases.en: What seems to be the problem?
phrases.vi: Bạn thấy không ổn ở chỗ nào?

phrases.en: How often should I take this medicine?
phrases.vi: Tôi nên uống thuốc này mấy lần một ngày?

phrases.en: Do I need a prescription for this?
phrases.vi: Mua thuốc này có cần đơn không?

phrases.en: Take two tablets after meals.
phrases.vi: Uống hai viên sau bữa ăn.

phrases.en: Are there any side effects?
phrases.vi: Thuốc có tác dụng phụ nào không?

phrases.vi: Làm ơn gọi xe cứu thương!

phrases.en: He can't breathe!
phrases.vi: Anh ấy không thở được!

phrases.en: She fell and hit her head.
phrases.vi: Cô ấy ngã và đập đầu.

phrases.en: I think I've broken my wrist.
phrases.vi: Tôi nghĩ mình bị gãy cổ tay.

phrases.en: Is there a first aid kit nearby?
phrases.vi: Gần đây có hộp sơ cứu không?

phrases.en: I'm trying to eat more vegetables.
phrases.vi: Tôi đang cố ăn nhiều rau hơn.

phrases.en: I go jogging three times a week.
phrases.vi: Tôi chạy bộ ba lần một tuần.

phrases.en: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
phrases.vi: Tôi đang cố giảm đường.

phrases.en: I need to get more sleep.
phrases.vi: Tôi cần ngủ nhiều hơn.

phrases.en: I quit smoking last year.
phrases.vi: Tôi đã bỏ thuốc lá từ năm ngoái.

phrases.en: I've been feeling really stressed lately.
phrases.vi: Dạo này tôi thấy rất căng thẳng.

phrases.en: I can't sleep because I keep worrying.
phrases.vi: Tôi không ngủ được vì cứ lo nghĩ.

phrases.en: Talking to someone really helps me.
phrases.vi: Nói chuyện với ai đó giúp tôi nhiều lắm.

phrases.vi: Bảo hiểm của tôi có chi trả cho điều trị này không?

phrases.vi: Tôi muốn nộp yêu cầu bồi thường bảo hiểm.

lines: A
What's the matter? You look uncomfortable.
Có chuyện gì vậy? Trông bạn không thoải mái.
B
My back is really stiff. I think it's from sitting all day.
Lưng tôi cứng đờ. Chắc do ngồi cả ngày.
A
Try some stretching. It always helps my neck too.
Thử giãn cơ đi. Cách này cũng luôn giúp cổ tôi.
Doctor
How did you hurt your knee?
Bạn bị đau đầu gối thế nào?
Patient
I fell while running. My ankle is swollen too.
Tôi ngã khi chạy bộ. Mắt cá chân cũng bị sưng.
Doctor
Let me take a look. Does it hurt when I press here?
Để tôi xem. Tôi ấn vào đây bạn có đau không?
Patient
Yes, a sharp pain. Is it serious?
Có, đau nhói. Có nghiêm trọng không?
A
You don't look well. Are you sick?
Trông bạn không khỏe. Bạn ốm à?
B
I have a fever and a bad cough since yesterday.
Tôi bị sốt và ho nhiều từ hôm qua.
A
It might be the flu. Stay home and drink plenty of water.
Có thể là cúm. Hãy ở nhà và uống thật nhiều nước.
Nurse
Are you allergic to any food or medicine?
Bạn có dị ứng với thức ăn hay thuốc nào không?
Patient
I'm allergic to peanuts. I get a rash and itchy eyes.
Tôi dị ứng với đậu phộng. Tôi bị nổi mẩn và ngứa mắt.
Nurse
Thank you. I'll write that in your notes.
Cảm ơn bạn. Tôi sẽ ghi vào hồ sơ.
A
Hello, I'd like to make an appointment, please.
Xin chào, tôi muốn đặt lịch hẹn.
B
Is it for a check-up or a problem?
Là khám định kỳ hay có vấn đề cụ thể?
A
Just a check-up. Do you have anything on Friday?
Chỉ khám định kỳ. Thứ Sáu còn lịch không?
B
Yes, 10 a.m. Please wait in the waiting room when you arrive.
Có, 10 giờ sáng. Khi đến bạn vui lòng chờ ở phòng chờ.
Pharmacist
Here is your medicine. Take one tablet after dinner.
Thuốc của bạn đây. Uống một viên sau bữa tối.
Patient
Are there any side effects?
Thuốc có tác dụng phụ nào không?
Pharmacist
You may feel sleepy, so don't drive afterwards.
Bạn có thể buồn ngủ, nên đừng lái xe sau đó.
A
Help! My father can't breathe!
Cứu với! Bố tôi không thở được!
B
Stay calm. I'm calling an ambulance now.
Bình tĩnh. Tôi gọi xe cứu thương ngay đây.
A
Please hurry, he's very pale.
Làm ơn nhanh lên, ông tái nhợt lắm.
A
Ouch! I cut my finger and it's bleeding a lot.
Ối! Tôi cắt vào ngón tay và chảy nhiều máu.
B
Press on it. I'll get the first aid kit.
Ấn chặt vào. Tôi đi lấy hộp sơ cứu.
A
Thanks. Can you put a bandage on it?
Cảm ơn. Bạn băng vết thương giúp tôi nhé?
A
Your lunch looks really healthy today.
Bữa trưa của bạn hôm nay trông rất lành mạnh.
B
I'm trying a balanced diet with more vegetables.
Tôi đang thử chế độ ăn cân bằng với nhiều rau hơn.
A
Good idea. I should cut down on sugar too.
Ý hay đấy. Tôi cũng nên giảm đường.
A
Do you go to the gym often?
Bạn có hay đến phòng tập không?
B
Three times a week. A short workout keeps me fit.
Ba lần một tuần. Buổi tập ngắn giúp tôi giữ dáng.
A
I should start. Where do you stretch afterwards?
Tôi nên bắt đầu thôi. Sau đó bạn giãn cơ ở đâu?
B
Right there on the mat. It only takes five minutes.
Ngay trên tấm thảm kia. Chỉ mất năm phút.
A
You seem stressed lately. Are you sleeping well?
Dạo này bạn có vẻ căng thẳng. Bạn ngủ ngon không?
B
Not really. I keep worrying about work.
Không hẳn. Tôi cứ lo chuyện công việc.
A
Try a short walk to relax. It helps me a lot.
Thử đi bộ một chút để thư giãn. Cách này giúp tôi nhiều lắm.
A
Does my insurance cover this treatment?
Bảo hiểm của tôi có chi trả điều trị này không?
B
Yes, but you must file a claim within thirty days.
Có, nhưng bạn phải nộp yêu cầu bồi thường trong vòng ba mươi ngày.
A
Do I pay anything first?
Tôi có phải trả trước khoản nào không?
B
Only the deductible. The rest is covered.
Chỉ khoản tự chi trả ban đầu. Phần còn lại được chi trả.
